treatMutexTimeoutAsWarning.description: Whether failure to acquire the exclusive execution lock is treated as a warning rather than a failure.

configuration.description: Custom configuration names and values as stored. Settings whose names start with gRPC- or httpRequest- (case-insensitive) are excluded.

id.description: Stable Job ID used to retrieve details within this Dataset.

enabled.description: Whether the Job is enabled for scheduling and enqueueing. This does not indicate that it is currently running.

cronExpression.description: Configured cron expression evaluated in UTC. Null means no expression was configured; an enabled Job does not necessarily run periodically.

lastStarted.description: Latest recorded execution start time; null when no start has been recorded.

lastFinished.description: Latest recorded execution finish time; null when no finish has been recorded. This may belong to an earlier execution than lastStarted.

lastResult.description: Latest recorded result: completed, completedWithWarnings, or faulted. Null means no result is recorded. It may belong to an earlier execution than lastStarted.

updated.description: Time the Job configuration was last updated.

description: Marketing Automation Triggers Job details with common metadata and custom configuration.
